title: The Call of the Wild
author: Jack London
description: Buck is drawn from domestic comfort into the harsh world of the northern wilderness.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
editionCredits: Ryan, Kirstin, Linda and Rick Trapp and David Widger
longDescription: Movement, unfamiliar places and difficult choices carry the reading experience forward. Alongside the excitement, the story asks what loyalty, resourcefulness and courage look like under pressure. Its historical setting also reflects the assumptions of its period, which modern readers may wish to consider critically.

authorInfo.bio: John Griffith London, better known as Jack London, was an American novelist, journalist and activist. A pioneer of commercial fiction and American magazines, he was one of the first American authors to become an international celebrity and earn a large fortune from writing.
